featured_reviews.review_text:
"Let me take a moment to express my admiration for Zerox Shop. This establishment truly embodies convenience and excellence in every aspect. Firstly, their printing services are top-notch, delivering crisp, high-quality prints in a timely manner. Whether it's documents, flyers, or posters, they handle it with professionalism and precision.

Moreover, their extensive range of school accessories is a godsend for students and parents alike. From notebooks to stationery sets, they have everything one might need to kickstart a successful academic journey. It's a relief to find such a comprehensive selection all under one roof.

But wait, there's more! Zerox Shop goes above and beyond by offering money transfer facilities, making it a convenient stop for various financial transactions. This added service sets them apart from your average print shop and adds immense value to their offerings.

And let's not forget about their graphic design services. Whether you're a business owner in need of branding materials or an individual looking to create custom designs, their talented team is ready to bring your vision to life. Their attention to detail and creative flair truly shine through in every project they undertake.

What truly sets Zerox Shop apart, however, is their exceptional customer service. The staff here are always friendly, approachable, and eager to assist with any inquiries or requests. They create a welcoming atmosphere that keeps customers coming back time and time again.

In conclusion, Zerox Shop is more than just a print shop – it's a hub of convenience and creativity. Whether you're printing documents, shopping for school supplies, transferring money, or seeking graphic design services, you can trust Zerox Shop to deliver outstanding results with a smile."

featured_reviews.review_text:
On 21st September 2024 we had purchased this 6x6 Rubik's Cube from this damn Anupam stationery. They sweetly did not issue the bill and on trust we took the product. Next day some pieces poped out and when we had gone for replacement they refused to accept as we had no bill. What a scam ? Guys better buy online they never do this. Also offline stores pls don't cry "you don't get business nowadays".  This is what you do to your customers when they trust you Huh.
-–------------------------
The story continues and this time it's positive. Guys got a call from Mr.Sachin Shah floor manager on 25/02/25 (6months later is better late than never :)} Anupam Stationery and he took cognizance of the issue and has give a replacement product. All is well that ends well. I am upgrading the ratings from 1 to 3.5. I am always for offline buying it gives product with a buying experience which online can never give. Once again kudos to Sachin Shah from Anupam Stationery for not ignoring even small issues. Well Done Dear Sachin💐

featured_reviews.review_text: One stop shop for all the stationary items. Located in Borivali West just opposite station.
